atomic_expansion_protocol: Commit an exact-revision inventory with stable row identities, owners, sinks, counts, and hashes.
Partition deterministically by replacement owner, old producer, and compatible gate set; record zero-row proofs.
Generate the complete proposed child bodies, blockers, capstone edges, and downstream edge additions.
Obtain a separate user ratification for the concrete numbered expansion.
Create children without readiness labels, make every child natively blocked by its still-open inventory, and add every child to its capstone.
Add capstone and wave blockers to downstream issues before closing the inventory; edges are added before any edge is removed.
Re-fetch bodies, state, labels, comments, and native endpoints; prove row union, uniqueness, acyclicity, and body-edge equality.
Apply readiness only after the audit and append its inventory and graph hashes.
Close the inventory only after all preceding steps pass; on failure leave staged children non-ready.

same_slice_obligations: Update BookCoverageManifest and owning Book material.
Run the full gate on one immutable candidate pair.
Attest and promote the new exact pair before the feature ticket closes.
public_behavior_book_gate.gap_policy: Every gap is runnable coverage, intrinsically illustrative with reason and authority, a concrete owned implementation or evidence gap, a stale claim to deprecate, remove, or tombstone forward, or an immediate invalid/unclassified failure; a broken current surface retains its status and owner and is never illustrative or relabelled planned.

native_execution_witness.scope: Every native claim identifies the exact function, verified artifact, installation and later dispatch event, plus covered fallback or deoptimization.

external_dependencies.role: Retained legacy program blocker until every obligation has a replacement owner.
Pre-existing callable carrier prerequisite; its old #90 gate is replaced by the migration guard.

entries.title: Prove real execution for every declared mode

entries.title: Verify structured compiler and LSP diagnostics

entries.title: Verify native execution witnesses

entries.title: Build distributed and operator gate fixtures

entries.title: Close the complete public-feature denominator

entries.title: Close complete bidirectional Book coverage

entries.title: Run the complete current Book universe

entries.title: Define immutable pair evidence and accepted-pair transitions

expansion_templates.partition_rule: Exact rows share provider or host-observation owner and one gate set.
Exact routes share publication domain, producer, sink, stage, and verification matrix.
Exact rows share checked-builder owner and old parser or insertion path.
Exact rows share semantic fact, LSP surface, and bounded consumer family.
Measured rows share catalog family, replacement owner, sink set, and verification matrix; zero-row families emit nothing.
Exact rows share feature family, semantic owner, status policy, evidence matrix, and manifest writer.
Exact gaps share page family, fixture class, mode set, semantic owner, and one operator or security contract.

conditions: The authority baseline, all three bounded inventories, and guard have real IDs.
Bodies and native endpoints agree before old edges are removed.
Concrete D-wave edges are added before DISCOVERY-ROUTE-INVENTORY closes.
Every target tracer has a real ID and complete transitive prerequisites.
Every surviving #22 obligation has a replacement owner.

ratification_forks.question: Ratify 89 publish-now nodes while keeping seven inventory expansions as non-issue templates?
ratification_forks.recommended: Publish only the complete fixed and bounded inventory tickets; separately ratify every concrete expansion.

ratification_forks.question: Ratify protected external candidates, attestations, and monotone AcceptedPairTransitions instead of manifest-local revisions or reciprocal pins?
ratification_forks.recommended: Use external exact-revision evidence and a signed compare-and-swap transition as sole current-pair authority.

ratification_forks.question: Require exact inventory row IDs, counts, hashes, owners, sinks, and gate sets before any wave becomes a GitHub issue?
ratification_forks.recommended: Require the atomic expansion protocol and leave templates non-claimable until its audit passes.
